errors.text_span: Оста X е обозначена с етикета „Коефициент на безработица (15-64 г., %)“
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the chart's main title, 'Коефициент на безработица (15-64 г., %)' (Unemployment rate (15-64 y, %)), as the label for the X-axis. The X-axis represents the years from 2016 to 2020 and does not have a separate textual label.

errors.text_span: достига връх от около 10 през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description for the 'област Ловеч' (Lovech province) line states that it reaches a peak in 2018. According to the chart, the peak for this series is in 2017, with a value of approximately 10.5%. The value in 2018 is lower, at around 9.5%.
